patterns.usage_note: Covers four related jobs: the means used (話[はな]し合[あ]いによって), the agent of a passive (名工[めいこう]によって建[た]てられた), the cause (不注意[ふちゅうい]によって), and variation from case to case (人[ひと]によって違[ちが]う). The variation reading needs a noun that names a set of cases plus a predicate of difference, so it is the one learners should keep distinct from the rest. The whole pattern is formal; conversation usually reaches for で or 〜次第[しだい]. による is the prenominal form and により the clipped written shape; によっては (casually によっちゃ) is a separate, topic-marked shape that only carries the "depending on the case" reading.

examples.ruby: 好[この]みは人[ひと]によって大[おお]きく違[ちが]うものだ。
examples.english: Tastes vary widely from person to person.

examples.ruby: 話[はな]し合[あ]いによって問題[もんだい]を解決[かいけつ]したい。
examples.english: I'd like to settle the matter through discussion.

examples.ruby: この寺[てら]は江戸時代[えどじだい]の名工[めいこう]によって建[た]てられた。
examples.english: This temple was built by a master craftsman of the Edo period.
